content.short: TON DNS allows users to assign human-readable names to their complex wallet addresses for easier transactions.
content.description: TON DNS (Domain Name System) is a foundational service for The Open Network that enhances the user experience by replacing long, complex wallet addresses with human-readable names (e.g., 'yourname.ton'). These domains are stored as NFTs on the blockchain, ensuring that owners have full control over their digital identity. TON DNS makes it significantly easier to send and receive funds, access decentralized websites, and interact with various ecosystem services, making the TON blockchain more accessible to everyday users.
content.meta: Claim your .ton domain with TON DNS. Simplify your Web3 identity and transactions on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
